### New Wine for New Wineskins
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/new-wine-new-wineskins
Passage: Mark 2:21-22
Points:
- Religious disciplines and practices can be helpful aids, but treating them as divine mandates becomes spiritually burdensome.
- Jesus did not conform to rigid traditions because God was doing a fresh work that required adjusted expectations.
- Unshrunk cloth tears old fabric and fermenting wine bursts rigid wineskins, showing that old containers cannot hold what is new.
- Attempting to force Christ into preconceived human patterns leads to spiritual harm.
- Believers must never make secondary traditions absolute, lest those forms prevent them from being reformed by God's Word.
